title: LCS
definition: Finding the longest subsequence present in both strings. Requires a 2D DP table. If `s1[i] == s2[j]`, `dp[i][j] = 1 + dp[i-1][j-1]`. Otherwise, `max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])`.
simpleExplanation: Finding the longest hidden message that two completely different scrambled words share in common.

answers.question: **Expert:** Longest Common Subsequence
